scripts.desktop:dist: rm -rf "dist" && yarn build && electron-packager . "Daily Time Logger" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=dist --overwrite --prune=false --asar=false --extra-resource="../backend" --ignore="^/dist$" --ignore="^/\.next/cache$"
scripts.desktop:dmg: yarn desktop:dist && rm -f "dist/Daily-Time-Logger-mac-arm64.dmg" && hdiutil create -volname "Daily Time Logger" -srcfolder "dist/Daily Time Logger-darwin-arm64/Daily Time Logger.app" -ov -format UDZO "dist/Daily-Time-Logger-mac-arm64.dmg"
